description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest .NET LTS framework.
tasks.reason: The modernization request explicitly requires moving to the latest framework before cloud-native migration work.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the solution from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10 LTS and ensure project format/runtime compatibility required for subsequent Azure modernization tasks.

tasks.description: Modernize core app integrations to Azure cloud-native services.
tasks.reason: The modernization goal requires cloud-native service adoption for configuration, identity, and data connectivity.
tasks.requirements: Modernize the application to use Azure cloud-native services by adopting managed identity authentication, moving non-secret configuration to Azure App Configuration, using Azure SQL Database connectivity patterns, and aligning application authentication with Microsoft Entra ID.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required for every modernization plan to reduce known vulnerability risk.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities to minimum patched versions. When major upgrades are required, document dependency, current version, target major version, and breaking-change risk. Verify build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The modernization request explicitly requires deployment of the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps with Azure-native deployment configuration and runtime settings.
